aboutDescription: Native EarthBound for Windows: MaternalBound Redux, original mode/title option, widescreen/4K, MSU music, controllers, sprint/stamina, QoL, save recovery and Story Shuffle. Experimental; supply your own clean USA ROM.
limits: Selected title, launcher, saved-checkpoint and basic runtime regression coverage only. No full campaign/randomized or hardware/listening certification.
Unchanged setup helpers and MSU install contracts retain previous verification; no repeated online ROM extraction/music download.
sourceNote: The release tag identifies the build/source checkpoint. Publication receipt and documentation encoding corrections were added after tagging; they do not change the archived binaries.
